lines.text: Ms. Spellen.
Professor.
Headmistress, technically.
I thought you disliked ceremony.
I dislike unnecessary ceremony. Accuracy is another matter.
Professor Ashcombe left this to you.
Why?
I asked him that once.
And?
He said, 'If she ever comes, let her discover that for herself.'
He sounds irritating.
Profoundly.
So, I'm not here to investigate his death.
You are here because he entrusted private research to you. What you do with what you discover is another matter.
And if I discover the report is wrong?
Then bring me evidence, not intuition.
That means something to you.
Maybe.
Good. That is precisely why he chose you instead of me. Keep 'maybe' until you have earned something stronger.
You really are going to make me work for every sentence, aren't you?

I believe Professor Ashcombe would have approved. You can begin your investigation by investigating Professor Ashcombe's room. When you're finished come back here to see me and I will take you to the crime scene.
Ms. Spellen, a word of caution. Don't try to become Professor Ashcombe. He spent a lifetime becoming himself. Become the investigator only you can become.
Do you believe she is ready?
No.....Neither was he.
